description_zh: 事故发生在 Cesar Chavez Street 与 Guerrero Street 的平面十字交叉口（两条道路均为多车道城市干道），故选用 cross_intersection/townArterial；ego 东行方向明确有两条车道（“leftmost of two lanes”），对向按城市干道默认两条，故 forward=2、backward=2；中心线虚实未提及，保守取 broken 以保留借道空间。

source_snippets: a collision involving an ambulance on Cesar Chavez Street at Guerrero Street
The Waymo AV was traveling east in the leftmost of two lanes on Cesar Chavez Street
While the traffic light was yellow, the Waymo AV began to cross the intersection with Guerrero Street
an ambulance traveling north on Guerrero Street ... began to make a right turn onto eastbound Cesar Chavez Street
ADDRESS/LOCATION OF ACCIDENT: Cesar Chavez Street at Guerrero Street
evidence.reason: 输入明确给出“Cesar Chavez Street at Guerrero Street”且在黄灯下穿越路口，事故地点本身是平面交叉口，因此 topology 必须取 cross_intersection（四向 approach 与所有直行/左转/右转已隐含，无需列 allowed maneuvers）。Cesar Chavez Street 为旧金山多车道城市干道，ego 东行方向明确“两条车道中最左侧”，故 forward=2；对向车道数未明示，按城市干道对称默认 backward=2。type 取 townArterial（多车道干道）。center_line 未提及，按默认规则取 broken。
